Name: CPM Dim Business Unit Update from DL inc Clone
Code@Code.link: CPM Dim Business Unit Update from DL inc Clone.ti

DataSource.query:
SET NOCOUNT ON; 
  SELECT distinct businessUnit
  FROM [dbo].[Actual_Expenses]
  UNION
  SELECT 
      distinct [BusinessUnit]
  FROM [dbo].[ActualCM]

Parameters.Prompt: To enable or disable Process Log - Y/N
